scifact_index_receipt.scope: PG and Qdrant are rehydrated as a read-side benchmark fixture from pinned text/vector files. QASPER papers exercised the HTTP upload and Celery worker in this run.
scifact_index_receipt.filters: workspace, KB and snapshot revision membership enforced on read; separate full collection preserves corpus IDF

scope_description: Fresh immutable snapshots shared exactly by all arms within each corpus. SciFact original public title+abstract corpus and pinned existing vectors fully rehydrated in scoped PG/Qdrant. QASPER seven papers uploaded by the public document route; Celery ingested full body (captions excluded); separate title+abstract vectors are used only for parent retrieval.

baseline_equivalence.check: AST of retrieve_with_trace after inlining the new default hook is identical to frozen baseline; default hook returns the exact original fuse_reciprocal_rank call, with identical argument AST.

controls: The synthetic memorandum is absent from this run’s two knowledge snapshots. Unlike the previous trial, this run did not upload it to another tenant or retest access-control boundaries.
capture_semantics: Every planned dispatch first saved a pending marker, then the HTTP result; no model retries. Subsequent changes strengthen the reusable capture driver with ordered cohort, scope and source hashes. Historical first responses have the original recorded fields.
cost: The 51 prespecified requests plus one post-hoc title diagnostic are the only authorized model requests in this benchmark. HTTP readiness, replay preparation and citation verification invoke no model generation.
execution_notes: Initial job completed all 30 SciFact responses, then stopped before the first QASPER dispatch due to a local Qdrant-client context-manager incompatibility. Corrected lifecycle, then ran all 21 untouched QASPER requests once; prior SciFact results persisted. No paid requests repeated.
